title: Dependency Free stringr
text: stringb provides zero-dependency (mostly) drop replacement stringr implemented top base R regular expressions. useful finding stringr’s stringi dependency onerous users (since requires compilation large unicode database). stringb match stringr behaviour much possible. main exceptions listed : stringb uses either Perl-compatible regexps (default) POSIX 1003.2 extended regexps (regexp()). large, represent subsets ICU backed engine stringi provides, maybe subtle differences edge cases. stringr always returns UTF-8 encoded strings; stringb follows rules base R. stringr functions recycled arguments. stringb provides much limited recycling: pattern recycled; str_sub() recycles start stop, string.
